description: This file defines the ITimerRegistry interface, an abstraction for managing grain timers in Orleans. It includes method signatures for creating timers, some marked as obsolete, and documentation comments describing their usage.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Creates a grain timer with specified callback, delay, and period.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Creates a grain timer with detailed options, supporting different callback signatures and creation options.
